integrity.proof_basis: analytic tour determinant, resistance identity and all-parameter monotonicity

scientific_limitations: Only uniform directed-edge chains on one-vertex bouquets of m>=2 unweighted simple cycles of lengths >=3 are classified; no results about vertex-projected constants, arbitrary cactus graphs, general weights, or mixing time. Special finite cases may have appeared in prior numerical enumerations; independent audit and definitive priority assessment not performed.
title: A sharp edge-space Kemeny comparison on arbitrary cycle bouquets
